messages:
maya: quick thread — can we lock down RN copy + deploy timing for Thu change window (2026-03-26 21:00 UTC)? need pin decision, canary %, and rollback lanes.
liam: +1. perf looks good on staging for v2.4.1-quant. recommend pin to v2.4.1-quant on Dedicated for this rollout. fallback image: v2.4.0-quant.
ana: (typo) ana: I can draft the internal snippet. do we want 1-line TL;DR + 3 bullets? who should be called out?
jay: oncall for that window: @jay + @liam. escalate to eng-sre if p95 > 800ms OR error rate > 1% sustained for 5m. rollback if user-facing failures increase or canary fails health checks.
maya: sounds good. canary plan? 10% for 30m then 50% for 15m then full if green?
liam: that plan works. propose route: dedicated-us-west -> dedicated-eu for canary sequencing. will monitor cost/latency.
liam: deploybot command I'll run:
```
/deploy start --target dedicated-us-west --image redwood/model:v2.4.1-quant --canary 10% --notes "canary test: latency + error checks"
```
ops-bot: deploybot: queued deploy job 3324500123: redwood/model:v2.4.1-quant -> dedicated-us-west (canary 10%). started by liam.
ops-bot: deploybot: canary started — healthcheck streaming: https://deploys.redwood.internal/3324500123
ana: internal RN draft (first pass):
- TL;DR: deploy v2.4.1-quant to Dedicated to improve throughput and tail latency.
- Impact: no schema changes, traffic routed gradually via canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%). expect brief increased CPU on worker pool.
- Rollback criteria: p95 latency > 800ms or error rate > 1% for 5m, or service errors > 0.5% users affected.
- Contacts: @jay (oncall), @liam (release lead), #eng-releases for updates.
maya: nice. can you shorten the TL;DR to one line and add the internal link to the evals dashboard? also include the pin version explicitly.
nana: updated snippet: "Rolling v2.4.1-quant to Dedicated (pinned). Canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Rollback: p95>800ms or error rate>1% for 5m. Oncall: @jay, @liam. Eval dashboard: https://evals.redwood.internal/runs/9876"
liam: started canary monitor checks. if any failing, I'll run:
```
/deploy rollback --job 3324500123 --to-image redwood/model:v2.4.0-quant --reason "canary failing"
```
ops-bot: deploybot: canary healthy after 22m — error rate 0.08%, p95 320ms. proceeding to 50% in 5m.
jay: I'll be watching logs + tracing. will post any anomalies here.
maya: once 50% healthy, I'll finalize the internal announce and schedule a 1h post-deploy check-in in calendar. thanks all :thumbsup:
liam: noted. tagging PROD_CONFIG: pin=model:v2.4.1-quant; fallback=v2.4.0-quant; change-window=2026-03-26T21:00Z.
ops-bot: deploybot: scaled canary to 50% (dedicated-us-west + dedicated-eu). job 3324500123.
ops-bot: deploybot: full rollout queued, awaiting manual approval from release lead.
maya: liam — please approve full rollout when green. I'll send the internal blurb once approved.
liam: approving full rollout if no regressions in 25m. :eyes:
ops-bot: deploybot: last update timestamp 3324500300.
